important_boundary: This artifact records extracted mechanisms from frozen external revisions. It does not establish native reconstruction, implementation, execution, verification, qualification, or authority.

records.mechanism: Contextual rule evaluation over agent traces/tool calls, including ordered relationships between events; guardrails can intercept requests through proxy/gateway layers.
records.baseline_delta: MANIFEX requires explicit immutable trajectory identity, authority snapshot, deterministic replay, and resistance to caller-forged verification/approval; exact delta requires source-level extraction.

records.mechanism: Composable benchmark environment separating attacks, defenses, agents/pipelines, task suites, tool/function runtime, and result collection; supports multi-step user/injection tasks.
records.baseline_delta: MANIFEX/AAL must preserve full trajectories and evidence integrity and add architectural forgery/authority-boundary attacks.

records.mechanism: Signed supply-chain layout defines authorized functionaries, ordered steps, artifact rules and inspections; signed link metadata records execution materials/products; verification checks signatures, authorization, commands, artifact rules and inspections.
records.baseline_delta: Native provenance must connect exact MANIFEX source/transformation/execution/product identities and independently derive verification rather than trust a caller flag.

records.mechanism: Build provenance model records how an artifact was produced, with buildDefinition and runDetails; SLSA Build levels progressively strengthen provenance generation, signing/authenticity, and build isolation/hardening.
records.baseline_delta: MANIFEX must map provenance to capability transformations and E0-E5 evidence without equating a SLSA level to KSI qualification or authority.

records.mechanism: Artifact signing and verification with signatures/certificates, identity constraints and transparency-log evidence; bundles can carry signature, certificate and transparency proof for offline verification.
records.baseline_delta: Native verifier must bind the verified artifact digest to the attestation/provenance and reject mismatched or caller-asserted verification state.

records.mechanism: Analyzable policy-based authorization engine intended to evaluate a request against policies and contextual attributes; Cedar is an authorization mechanism, not the source of KSI constitutional authority.
records.baseline_delta: KSI remains authoritative source of delegation; Cedar-style evaluation may decide policy applicability but cannot manufacture H0-H3 delegation or human approval.

records.mechanism: Adversarial AI testing framework organized around attacks/attack strategies, targets, converters, scorers, scenarios/scanners, memory/results and composable execution; supports multi-turn and multimodal adversarial testing.
records.baseline_delta: Native campaign engine must preserve deterministic trajectories, attack provenance, scorer correctness and evidence integrity; attack count alone is insufficient qualification.

records.mechanism: Declarative evaluation pipeline with providers/targets, test cases, assertions, scoring functions, thresholds, transforms, repetition/concurrency controls and red-team configuration.
records.baseline_delta: Native EVAL must separately validate evaluator correctness and target performance and preserve run-level provenance/evidence.

records.mechanism: Task abstraction composes dataset, solver and scorer; solvers can execute simple generation or multi-turn agents/tools; scorers produce scores and metrics; logs support evaluation and rescoring workflows.
records.baseline_delta: Native evaluation substrate should adopt common task/solver/scorer semantics while integrating KCN evaluation, MANIFEX provenance, CEI trajectories and E0-E5 evidence.
